annotations.title: Open swap orders of a wallet

description: Swap orders of a wallet that are still waiting at Minswap V2, SundaeSwap V3 or WingRiders V2 (unspent in the ledger right now), whichever app placed them: DEX, pool, amount sold, minimum to receive and when it was placed. Orders waiting at other DEXes are not listed; follow those with `get_swap_status`.
